g.text: Fresh Resin A/B/A shares one GPU; historical vLLM uses a separate allocation and different prompt tokens.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #425466

g.text: Actual committed tokens / continuous completion time; 20 warmup + 100 measured completions per point. No projections.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #425466

g.text: Labels show measured batches. Resin ends at its graph-capacity limit of 128; the historical vLLM 256 point is measured.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #425466

g.text: Native filtering differs: Resin top-p → top-k; vLLM top-k → top-p. Prompt artifacts differ (4529… vs 07cc…).

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #425466

g.text: Resin: full decode graphs + overlap. Historical vLLM: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graphs; async scheduling disabled.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #425466

g.text: Historical context only: separate allocations, workload differences and no cross-engine token-parity or matched-speedup claim.
